title: River Client 0.3.2
items: Improved: The Windows installer is back to about 230 MB instead of 1 GB. It carries River for Minecraft 1.21.11; other versions download the first time you play them.
Improved: The Mac and Linux downloads are smaller for the same reason.
Fixed: With FancyMenu installed, River's main menu no longer covers FancyMenu's custom menus.
